title: 院子里的香草  (Herbs from the Courtyard)

segments.t: In the kitchen, Mei whisks the eggs while Chen walks in holding fresh green herbs clipped from a courtyard pot as Qing sets the four breakfast tables. Listen first.
我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
小晴买了海盐黄油，今天我们做嫩炒蛋！
好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
老陈，这些香草是你自己种的吗？
总得有人照顾院子里的花草嘛。
闻闻看！热面包、热炒蛋，还有新鲜香草。
小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
我手表七点二十九分。客人下楼了。
四张桌子，八把椅子，全摆好了！
小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
Now let's go back through the lines together.
好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
'Good. Before serving them, sprinkle these fresh green herbs on top.' Mandarin puts 'before' after the event clause, so
之前
follows 'serving them' rather than opening the phrase.
老陈，这些香草是你自己种的吗？
'Chen, did you grow these herbs yourself?' Adding
自己
right after 'you' emphasizes 'by yourself'—grown with Chen's own hands.
总得有人照顾院子里的花草嘛。
'Somebody has to look after the courtyard plants, after all.' Joining 'flowers' and 'grass' forms
花草
the everyday collective word for garden plants and potted greenery.
闻闻看！热面包、热炒蛋，还有新鲜香草。
'Smell that! Warm bread, hot scrambled eggs, and fresh herbs.' Doubling 'smell' plus 'look' in
闻闻看
invites someone to 'take a whiff and see', using 'look' to mean 'try'.
每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
'Beside every blue cup, put one napkin and one small spoon.' Notice
每
for 'every': unlike English, it still keeps the counting word right between 'every' and 'blue cup'.
四张桌子，八把椅子，全摆好了！
'Four tables, eight chairs—everything is set in place!' Tables are flat surfaces counted with the flat-sheet word, whereas chairs have backs you grip and take the handle-word.
小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
'Qing, pour the hot water into the teapot—here they come!' Combining 'pour' with 'enter' gives
倒进
showing liquid moving straight into the teapot.
第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
'For day two on the job, nicely done, rookie.' Chen's gruff compliment calls Qing
新手
literally 'new hand', the natural Chinese term for a newcomer or rookie. Now let's hear the whole conversation again without stopping.
我在院子里老远就听到你们喊黄油了。
小晴买了海盐黄油，今天我们做嫩炒蛋！
好。端上去之前，在上面撒这些新鲜绿香草。
老陈，这些香草是你自己种的吗？
总得有人照顾院子里的花草嘛。
闻闻看！热面包、热炒蛋，还有新鲜香草。
小勺子和餐巾放在哪里？
每个蓝杯子旁边放一张餐巾和一把小勺子。
我手表七点二十九分。客人下楼了。
四张桌子，八把椅子，全摆好了！
小晴，把热水倒进茶壶里，他们来了！
第二天上班，干得不错，新手。
With one minute to spare, the four café tables are set and fragrant with warm bread and courtyard herbs. Next time, the guests come down to eat. See you next time.
回头见！
